ideas.pitch: An autonomous data cleaning and incident response agent built on Amazon product datasets to automatically fix missing attributes, correct erroneous taxonomies, and generate pull requests for catalog updates.
ideas.title: AmazonCatalogAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core premise of the Amazon ML Challenge by working with Amazon-scale datasets and utilizing data-engineering agent patterns that previously won the DataHub Agent Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A video intelligence platform tailored for Amazon sellers to convert unstructured product unboxing and review videos into searchable feature tags, sentiment analytics, and compliance checklists.
ideas.title: AWSBuilderVision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning strategy of the Data & Design Hackathon by tackling unstructured multimedia data and transforming it into enterprise-ready searchable assets.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance RAG and auto-embedding toolkit optimized for AWS database infrastructure to let internal Amazon category managers query vast vendor policies and historical sales trends instantly.
ideas.title: AmazonSemanticRAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of database-native RAG systems that secured top placements in recent database-centric hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A multi-turn evaluation benchmark specifically designed to test the reasoning limits and hallucination rates of large language models when performing automated product categorization tasks for e-commerce.
ideas.title: CatalogMetacognitionEval
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts award-winning metacognition benchmark frameworks to a high-value e-commerce domain, appealing directly to ML judges looking for rigorous evaluation methodologies.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous forecasting agent that simulates market demand, competitor pricing, and supply chain bottlenecks for newly proposed private-label Amazon products before they are greenlit.
ideas.title: AmazonExecutiveGreenlightAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements the complex agentic studio and simulation executive pattern that won top honors at the Agentic Cinema Hackathon.
